hrs_question: How long has the company been in business?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon Ridge Systems was founded in 2009 and has delivered asset and work management software continuously for 17 years. We are privately held and profitable, headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina.

hrs_question: How many customers use your solution?
hrs_answertext: More than 260 organizations use Halcyon products in production, including 140 public-sector agencies and 85 water, power and transportation utilities.

hrs_question: Provide client references.
hrs_answertext: We provide three to five references from comparable organizations on request. References for this response are listed in Appendix B and are drawn from implementations completed since 2021.

hrs_question: How many employees does the company have?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon employs 410 people: 120 in product engineering, 95 in implementation services, 60 in customer support and 135 in sales, finance and administration.

hrs_question: Provide audited financial statements.
hrs_answertext: Audited financial statements for fiscal years 2023 to 2025 are available under a mutual nondisclosure agreement. Halcyon has been cash-flow positive since 2014 and carries no long-term debt.

hrs_question: Describe your experience with public-sector clients.
hrs_answertext: Public-sector agencies account for 54% of our customer base. We have completed more than 180 implementations for cities, counties, water authorities, port authorities and state agencies across 31 states.

hrs_question: Describe your experience with utilities.
hrs_answertext: We serve 85 utilities, including 52 water and wastewater systems. Our utility templates cover linear assets, hydrants, valves, lift stations and treatment plant equipment.

hrs_question: Is the company subject to any litigation?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon has no pending litigation material to this engagement and has had no contract terminated for cause or default in the last five years.

hrs_question: Describe your product roadmap.
hrs_answertext: Our 24-month roadmap includes predictive maintenance models in Halcyon Insight, expanded GIS editing in FieldOps, and a low-code workflow designer. Roadmap items are shared under NDA and are not contractual commitments.

hrs_question: Do you use subcontractors?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon delivers all software and core services with its own employees. We do not plan to use subcontractors for this engagement unless the customer requests specialized data-conversion services.

hrs_question: Does the solution support offline mobile work?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon FieldOps runs offline on iOS, Android and Windows devices. Work orders, asset data, forms and maps are cached on the device and synchronize automatically when connectivity returns, with conflict detection.

hrs_question: How are work orders created?
hrs_answertext: Work orders can be created manually, from citizen or internal service requests, from failed inspection results, from preventive maintenance schedules, and through the REST API.

hrs_question: Does the solution support preventive maintenance scheduling?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Preventive maintenance schedules can be time-based, meter-based, condition-based or a combination. Schedules generate work orders automatically with configurable lead times.

hrs_question: Can work orders be assigned and dispatched?
hrs_answertext: FieldOps includes a drag-and-drop dispatch board with map and calendar views. Dispatchers assign work by crew, skill, location and availability, and changes push to mobile devices in near real time.

hrs_question: Does the solution track labor, materials and equipment on work orders?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Labor, materials, equipment and contractor costs are captured on each work order and roll up to the asset, project and cost center.

hrs_question: Can users attach photos and documents?
hrs_answertext: Field users can attach photos, video, documents and signatures to work orders and inspections. Attachments are stored with the record and are available offline once synchronized.

hrs_question: Does the solution support configurable inspection forms?
hrs_answertext: Administrators build inspection forms in a no-code designer with conditional logic, required fields, pick lists, numeric ranges and automatic follow-up work creation on failed items.

hrs_question: Can citizens submit service requests?
hrs_answertext: Yes. The Halcyon Request portal lets residents submit and track requests on the web or mobile, with map-based location, photos and status notifications. Requests can be converted to work orders automatically.

hrs_question: Does the solution track work order status and history?
hrs_answertext: Every work order keeps a full history of status changes, edits, assignments and comments, with user, timestamp and before-and-after values.

hrs_question: Can the solution manage crews and skills?
hrs_answertext: FieldOps maintains crews, technician skills, certifications and expiry dates. The dispatch board warns when an assignment requires a skill or certification the technician does not hold.

hrs_question: Does the solution maintain an asset registry?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon AssetIQ maintains an unlimited-depth asset hierarchy with parent-child and functional location relationships, configurable asset classes and attributes.

hrs_question: Does the solution support linear assets?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Linear assets such as water mains, sewer lines, roads and rail are supported with dynamic segmentation, so attributes and work can be recorded against a portion of an asset.

hrs_question: How does the solution handle condition assessment?
hrs_answertext: Condition assessments use configurable scales such as 1 to 5 or 0 to 100. Assessments are recorded from inspections or directly in AssetIQ and are trended over time for each asset.

hrs_question: Does the solution calculate asset risk?
hrs_answertext: AssetIQ calculates risk as likelihood of failure multiplied by consequence of failure, using configurable weighting. Risk scores update automatically when condition or criticality changes.

hrs_question: Does the solution track asset lifecycle costs?
hrs_answertext: All work order, contract and capital costs roll up to the asset, giving total cost of ownership from acquisition through disposal.

hrs_question: Does the solution integrate with GIS for assets?
hrs_answertext: AssetIQ integrates natively with Esri ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online. GIS can remain the system of record for spatial assets, with bidirectional attribute synchronization.

hrs_question: Can the solution support capital planning?
hrs_answertext: AssetIQ includes a capital planning module that models renewal scenarios over 1 to 50 years using risk, condition, remaining useful life and budget constraints.

hrs_question: Does the solution manage warranties?
hrs_answertext: Warranty terms are stored on each asset. Users are alerted when a work order is created for an asset under warranty, so the work can be routed to the vendor.

hrs_question: Does the solution support meter readings?
hrs_answertext: Assets can carry multiple meters such as run hours, cycles and mileage. Readings are entered manually, from mobile devices or through integration, and can trigger maintenance.

hrs_question: Can assets be bulk imported?
hrs_answertext: Assets can be bulk imported and updated through Excel or CSV templates with validation and preview, or through the REST API for larger volumes.

hrs_question: What reporting capabilities does the solution provide?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon includes more than 120 standard reports and dashboards covering work orders, backlog, preventive maintenance compliance, asset condition, costs and labor productivity.

hrs_question: Can users create their own reports?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Business users build ad hoc reports and dashboards in Halcyon Insight with a drag-and-drop designer, filters and scheduling, without IT involvement.

hrs_question: Does the solution provide dashboards?
hrs_answertext: Role-based dashboards are configurable per user group, with KPI tiles, charts, maps and drill-down to individual records.

hrs_question: Can reports be scheduled and distributed?
hrs_answertext: Reports can be scheduled daily, weekly or monthly and delivered by email as PDF, Excel or CSV, or published to a shared dashboard.

hrs_question: Does the solution support Power BI?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon provides a read-only analytics endpoint and a certified Power BI connector. Customers can also receive a nightly data export to their own data lake.

hrs_question: Does the solution report KPIs?
hrs_answertext: Standard KPIs include mean time to repair, mean time between failures, PM compliance, backlog age, wrench time and first-time fix rate.

hrs_question: Does the solution support predictive analytics?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon Insight includes failure-probability models trained on each customer's work history and condition data. Predictions are advisory and are shown with confidence ranges.

hrs_question: Can data be exported?
hrs_answertext: Any list, search result or report can be exported to Excel, CSV or PDF, subject to the user's security permissions.

hrs_question: Does the solution provide map-based analysis?
hrs_answertext: Work orders, requests and assets can be viewed on interactive maps with heat maps, clustering and spatial filters, using the customer's Esri basemaps.

hrs_question: Does the solution support regulatory reporting?
hrs_answertext: Templates are provided for common utility regulatory reports, including sanitary sewer overflow tracking and lead service line inventory reporting. Templates are configurable for state-specific formats.

hrs_question: Does the solution provide an API?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon provides a documented REST API with OpenAPI specifications covering work orders, assets, inspections, requests, inventory and users. OData endpoints are available for reporting.

hrs_question: Does the solution integrate with ERP systems?
hrs_answertext: We provide prebuilt connectors for Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP Cloud and Tyler Munis. Other ERPs are integrated through the REST API or file-based interfaces.

hrs_question: Does the solution support webhooks or events?
hrs_answertext: Configurable webhooks publish events when work orders, assets, inspections or requests are created or changed. Events include retry logic and delivery logs.

hrs_question: Does the solution integrate with Esri?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon is an Esri Partner Network member. We integrate with ArcGIS Enterprise 11.x and ArcGIS Online, including feature services, basemaps and Field Maps.

hrs_question: Does the solution integrate with CIS or billing systems?
hrs_answertext: Prebuilt integrations exist for Oracle Customer Cloud Service, SAP IS-U and Itineris. Service orders flow from the CIS to FieldOps and completion data flows back.

hrs_question: Does the solution integrate with SCADA or IoT?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon accepts alarms and readings from SCADA historians such as AVEVA PI and from Azure IoT Hub. Rules convert alarms or thresholds into work orders.

hrs_question: Does the solution support single sign-on integration?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping and ADFS, plus SCIM for user provisioning.

hrs_question: Are there API rate limits?
hrs_answertext: The standard API limit is 600 requests per minute per tenant with burst capacity. Higher limits are available for bulk integration windows. Limits are documented in the developer portal.

hrs_question: Does the solution support file-based integration?
hrs_answertext: Scheduled imports and exports in CSV, XML and JSON are supported over SFTP with PGP encryption, with validation reports and error notifications.

hrs_question: Does the solution integrate with Microsoft 365?
hrs_answertext: Notifications and approvals can be delivered through Outlook email and Microsoft Teams. Work order links open directly from Teams messages.

hrs_question: What is the hosting model?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon is delivered exclusively as multi-tenant software-as-a-service hosted on Microsoft Azure in US regions (East US 2 primary, Central US secondary). We do not offer on-premises deployment.

hrs_question: Where is customer data hosted?
hrs_answertext: All production, backup and disaster-recovery data is stored in Microsoft Azure data centers in the United States (East US 2 and Central US).

hrs_question: What browsers are supported?
hrs_answertext: The web application supports the two most recent versions of Edge, Chrome, Firefox and Safari with no plug-ins required.

hrs_question: What mobile platforms are supported?
hrs_answertext: FieldOps runs on iOS 16 and later, Android 12 and later, and Windows 11. Devices can be managed through Microsoft Intune or other MDM platforms.

hrs_question: How are upgrades delivered?
hrs_answertext: Upgrades are included in the subscription. Major releases are delivered quarterly in scheduled maintenance windows, with release notes and a preview sandbox available four weeks in advance.

hrs_question: Does the solution scale?
hrs_answertext: Our largest tenant supports 3,800 named users and 9.6 million asset records. The platform scales horizontally on Azure App Service and Azure SQL Hyperscale.

hrs_question: Are non-production environments provided?
hrs_answertext: Each subscription includes one sandbox environment refreshed from production on request. Additional environments are available as an option.

hrs_question: Does the solution meet accessibility standards?
hrs_answertext: The web and mobile applications conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Our latest VPAT (2.5, Section 508 and WCAG editions) is dated April 2026.

hrs_question: What languages does the solution support?
hrs_answertext: The user interface is available in English, Spanish and French. The citizen request portal additionally supports Vietnamese and Simplified Chinese.

hrs_question: What is the system architecture?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon uses a service-based architecture on Azure App Service, Azure SQL Hyperscale, Azure Blob Storage and Azure Service Bus, with .NET 8 services and a React web client.

hrs_question: How is data encrypted?
hrs_answertext: Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 using Azure-managed keys, and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher. Customer-managed keys are available as an option.

hrs_question: Does the solution support multi-factor authentication?
hrs_answertext: Yes. MFA is supported natively and through the customer's identity provider. Administrators can require MFA for all users or for specific roles.

hrs_question: How is access controlled?
hrs_answertext: Access is controlled through configurable roles and permissions down to field level, plus record-level security by department, crew or geography.

hrs_question: Does the solution log user activity?
hrs_answertext: All sign-ins, permission changes and data changes are logged with user, timestamp and IP address. Audit logs are retained for seven years and can be streamed to the customer's SIEM.

hrs_question: Do you hold SOC 2 Type II?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering security, availability and confidentiality for the period April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026, issued by an independent CPA firm. It is available under NDA.

hrs_question: Are you ISO 27001 certified?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon's information security management system is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. The current certificate is valid until February 14, 2028.

hrs_question: Do you perform penetration testing?
hrs_answertext: An independent firm performs penetration tests of the application and infrastructure at least annually and after major releases. Critical findings are remediated within 15 days; an executive summary is available under NDA.

hrs_question: How do you manage vulnerabilities?
hrs_answertext: We scan continuously with Microsoft Defender for Cloud and a third-party scanner. Remediation targets are 15 days for critical, 30 days for high and 90 days for medium vulnerabilities.

hrs_question: Do you conduct employee background checks?
hrs_answertext: All employees undergo criminal background, employment and education verification before hire. Security awareness training is completed at hire and annually.

hrs_question: What is your incident response process?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon maintains a documented incident response plan tested twice a year. We notify affected customers of a confirmed security breach involving their data within 72 hours of confirmation.

hrs_question: How long is data retained?
hrs_answertext: Retention periods are configurable by record type. By default all operational records are retained for the life of the subscription; audit logs are retained for seven years.

hrs_question: Who owns the data?
hrs_answertext: The customer owns all of its data. Halcyon processes customer data only to provide the service and does not sell or share it with third parties.

hrs_question: How is data returned at contract end?
hrs_answertext: On termination we provide a complete export in CSV and a SQL backup file within 30 days of request at no extra cost. Data is then securely deleted within 90 days and a certificate of destruction is issued.

hrs_question: Do you use customer data to train AI models?
hrs_answertext: No. Customer data is never used to train shared or third-party AI models. Predictive models in Halcyon Insight are trained only within the customer's own tenant.

hrs_question: Will you sign a privacy addendum?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon complies with applicable US state privacy laws and will execute the customer's reasonable data protection addendum. Personal data in the service is limited to employee and requester contact details.

hrs_question: Do you sign HIPAA business associate agreements?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon will sign a HIPAA business associate agreement where the service may process protected health information, although the standard configuration does not require PHI.

hrs_question: Can personal data be deleted on request?
hrs_answertext: Administrators can anonymize requester personal data on request while preserving the operational record. Deletion requests are logged for audit.

hrs_question: Where do your support staff access data from?
hrs_answertext: Customer data is accessed only by Halcyon employees located in the United States, using managed devices and just-in-time privileged access.

hrs_question: Do you use data subprocessors?
hrs_answertext: Our subprocessors are Microsoft Azure (hosting), Twilio (SMS notifications) and Zendesk (support ticketing). The current list is published on our trust portal with 30 days' notice of changes.

hrs_question: Does the solution support legal holds?
hrs_answertext: Records can be placed on legal hold by an administrator, which suspends retention-based deletion until the hold is released.

hrs_question: What is the availability SLA?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon commits to 99.9% monthly availability for production, excluding scheduled maintenance. Service credits apply if the commitment is missed.

hrs_question: What is your recovery point objective?
hrs_answertext: Our recovery point objective is 1 hour. Transaction logs are backed up continuously and geo-replicated to the secondary region.

hrs_question: What is your recovery time objective?
hrs_answertext: Our recovery time objective is 4 hours for a regional disaster, with failover to the Central US region.

hrs_question: How often are backups taken?
hrs_answertext: Full database backups are taken daily with continuous transaction log backups. Backups are encrypted and retained for 35 days, geo-redundant across two US regions.

hrs_question: Do you test disaster recovery?
hrs_answertext: We perform a full regional failover test annually and component restore tests quarterly. A summary of the latest test (March 2026) is available under NDA.

hrs_question: When are maintenance windows?
hrs_answertext: Planned maintenance occurs Sundays between 1:00 and 5:00 a.m. Eastern with at least seven days' notice. Emergency maintenance is communicated as early as possible.

hrs_question: Do you publish system status?
hrs_answertext: Service status and incident history are published at status.halcyonridge.example, with email and SMS subscriptions.

hrs_question: Do you provide service credits?
hrs_answertext: Service credits range from 5% to 25% of the monthly subscription fee depending on how far availability falls below 99.9%.

hrs_question: Is the solution geographically redundant?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Production runs in Azure East US 2 with geo-replication to Central US, more than 700 miles apart.

hrs_question: How is capacity monitored?
hrs_answertext: We monitor availability, response times and capacity 24x7 using Azure Monitor and Datadog, with automated scaling and on-call engineers.

hrs_question: Describe your implementation methodology.
hrs_answertext: We use Halcyon Launch, a five-phase methodology: Discover, Configure, Convert, Validate and Go-Live, followed by a 60-day hypercare period. Each phase ends with a customer sign-off gate.

hrs_question: What is a typical implementation timeline?
hrs_answertext: Typical implementations take 6 to 9 months for work and asset management and 4 to 6 months for work management alone. A proposed schedule with milestones is included in Section 6.

hrs_question: How is data conversion handled?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon converts assets, open work, PM schedules and up to five years of history from legacy systems using standard templates, with two trial conversions and reconciliation reports before go-live.

hrs_question: What training is provided?
hrs_answertext: Training includes administrator certification, train-the-trainer sessions for each user group, field crew sessions and on-demand courses in the Halcyon Academy learning portal.

hrs_question: Who will be on the project team?
hrs_answertext: Our proposed team includes a project manager, a solution architect, a data conversion lead, a GIS integration specialist and a training lead. Résumés are provided in Appendix C.

hrs_question: How is project management performed?
hrs_answertext: Each implementation has a dedicated PMP-certified project manager who maintains the schedule, risk log and status reports and leads weekly status meetings.

hrs_question: How is testing performed?
hrs_answertext: We provide standard test scripts tailored to the customer's configuration, support two UAT cycles and track defects in a shared log with agreed resolution targets.

hrs_question: What change management support is provided?
hrs_answertext: Our change management package includes stakeholder analysis, communication templates, champion networks and adoption dashboards for the first 90 days after go-live.

hrs_question: Is the implementation remote or on-site?
hrs_answertext: Implementations are delivered in a hybrid model. Discovery workshops, training and go-live support are on site; configuration and data conversion are delivered remotely.

hrs_question: What is included in post-go-live support?
hrs_answertext: A 60-day hypercare period follows go-live with daily check-ins for the first two weeks and priority defect resolution before transition to standard support.

hrs_question: What support hours are provided?
hrs_answertext: Standard support is available 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Eastern, Monday to Friday, with 24x7 coverage for Priority 1 issues.

hrs_question: What are your support response times?
hrs_answertext: Response targets are 1 hour for Priority 1, 4 business hours for Priority 2, 1 business day for Priority 3 and 2 business days for Priority 4.

hrs_question: How do customers log support requests?
hrs_answertext: Support requests can be logged through the customer portal, by email or by phone. Priority 1 issues should be reported by phone for immediate escalation.

hrs_question: Is there an escalation process?
hrs_answertext: Unresolved issues escalate from the support engineer to the support manager, then to the Director of Customer Success and the VP of Engineering, with defined time triggers at each level.

hrs_question: Is a customer success manager assigned?
hrs_answertext: Every customer is assigned a named customer success manager who holds quarterly business reviews and coordinates roadmap and adoption planning.

hrs_question: Is support included in the subscription?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Standard support, maintenance and upgrades are included in the subscription fee. Premium support with extended hours is available as an option.

hrs_question: Do you provide a knowledge base?
hrs_answertext: The Halcyon Help Center provides searchable product documentation, release notes, how-to videos and a community forum, available 24x7.

hrs_question: Do you have a user community?
hrs_answertext: Customers join the Halcyon User Community, with regional user groups, an annual conference and an online forum moderated by product managers.

hrs_question: How are enhancement requests handled?
hrs_answertext: Enhancement requests are submitted through the Ideas portal, where customers vote. Product management reviews requests quarterly and publishes status updates.

hrs_question: Do you report on support performance?
hrs_answertext: Monthly service reports cover availability, ticket volumes, response and resolution performance against targets, and open issues.

hrs_question: What is your pricing model?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon is licensed as an annual subscription based on named users and modules. Implementation services are priced separately as fixed-fee deliverables or time and materials.

hrs_question: What are your standard payment terms?
hrs_answertext: Our standard terms are annual subscription invoicing in advance, payable net 30 days. Services are invoiced monthly or on milestone acceptance.

hrs_question: What insurance coverage do you carry?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon carries commercial general liability of $2 million per occurrence and $4 million aggregate, professional liability of $5 million, cyber liability of $10 million and workers' compensation at statutory limits.

hrs_question: What is your limitation of liability?
hrs_answertext: Our standard limitation of liability is the fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim, with a higher cap of two times annual fees for breaches of data security obligations.

hrs_question: Do you provide IP indemnification?
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon will defend and indemnify the customer against third-party claims that the service infringes intellectual property rights.

hrs_question: Will you accept the agency's contract terms?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon accepts the sample agreement subject to the exceptions listed in the Exceptions Table, which focus on limitation of liability, service levels and data return.

hrs_question: Can pricing be held for future years?
hrs_answertext: Subscription pricing is fixed for the initial three-year term. Renewal increases are capped at 5% or CPI-U, whichever is lower.

hrs_question: Do you offer termination for convenience?
hrs_answertext: We accept termination for convenience on 90 days' written notice, effective at the end of the current paid subscription year.

hrs_question: Do you offer source code escrow?
hrs_answertext: Source code escrow is available through NCC Group at the customer's cost, with standard release conditions for insolvency or discontinuation of the service.

hrs_question: Are you registered to do business in the state?
hrs_answertext: Halcyon is registered to do business in all 50 states and will provide a certificate of good standing on request.

hrs_question: Does the solution provide map-based analysis? (detailed response)
hrs_answertext: Work orders, requests and assets can be viewed on interactive maps with heat maps, clustering and spatial filters, using the customer's Esri basemaps. hrs_question: Does the solution provide an API? (detailed response)

hrs_question: Does the solution support webhooks or events? (detailed response)

hrs_question: Does the solution integrate with CIS or billing systems? (detailed response)

hrs_question: Does the solution support single sign-on integration? (detailed response)
hrs_answertext: Yes. Halcyon supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping and ADFS, plus SCIM for user provisioning. Integrations are monitored from the administration console, with alerting on failures and a replay function for failed messages.

hrs_question: Does the solution support file-based integration? (detailed response)
